import datetime
import humanize
from datetime import timedelta

# Test R3: Very large time deltas
print('Testing R3 - large time deltas:')

# Very large delta
huge_delta = timedelta(days=999999999)  # ~2.7 million years
print(f'naturaldelta(huge_delta={huge_delta}) = {repr(humanize.naturaldelta(huge_delta))}')

# Even larger
very_huge = timedelta(days=999999999999)  # ~2.7 billion years
print(f'naturaldelta(very_huge_delta) = {repr(humanize.naturaldelta(very_huge))}')

# Test with timedelta.max
try:
    result = humanize.naturaldelta(timedelta.max)
    print(f'naturaldelta(timedelta.max) = {repr(result)}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'naturaldelta(timedelta.max) raised: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

# Test naturaltime with large delta
print(f'naturaltime(huge_delta) = {repr(humanize.naturaltime(huge_delta))}')

# Test negative large delta
neg_huge = -huge_delta
print(f'naturaldelta(neg_huge) = {repr(humanize.naturaldelta(neg_huge))}')
"
